identification.reported_issue: feed_titles reads RSS documents fetched from subscriber-supplied URLs. A feed that declares an external entity pointing at a local file might pull that file's contents into the returned titles. Analyze this component only.

source.quote:
def feed_titles(document: bytes) -> list[str]:
    handler = _Titles()
    parser = xml.sax.make_parser()
    parser.setFeature(feature_external_ges, True)
    parser.setContentHandler(handler)
    parser.parse(io.BytesIO(document))
    return handler.titles

source_files.content:
import feeds


def test_reads_titles():
    document = b"<rss><channel><title>News</title><item><title>First</title></item></channel></rss>"
    assert feeds.feed_titles(document) == ["News", "First"]
